intro: APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CyberAv3ngers were the top threat actors observed across 25 articles on critical-infrastructure from April 12 to June 26, 2026. The coverage included CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3), with high severity incidents dominating the mix at 15 reports, alongside three critical and three informational entries. Affected sectors spanned energy, government, and utilities, while regions included the United States, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
